messages:
leah_sales: Dropping ZEphyr (customer) pen-test artifacts to secure bucket per their request. Need guidance on what we can share and timeline. link: https://secure.redwood.example/zephyr/2025001111 :paperclip:
infra_bot: Artifacts stored at s3://redwood-secure/zephyr/2025001111/
  - report: zephyr-pt-final.pdf
  - scan-xml: zephyr-scan.xml.gz
  - pocs: zephyr-pocs.tar.gz
  - manifest: zephyr-manifest.json
  - checksums: zephyr-2025001111.sha256
omar_se: quick flag 1: some PoCs include internal hostnames and one leaked service token. we cannot send raw until scrubbed.
mika_eng: agree. i'll run the sanitizer and convert any runnable exploits to pseudo-PoCs. ETA: batch job tonight, will push sanitized bundle by 2025006000.
vijay_ciso: Conditions for sharing: (1) sanitized bundle only unless NDA addendum signed; (2) include CVSS, exploitability and auth-required flags in manifest; (3) assign security contact for triage. propose SLA: critical=3 days, high=14 days, medium=30 days.
leah_sales: ZEphyr asked for 30 days. can we offer critical=3 days and push product hotfix for high in 10 days? they want weekly updates.
omar_se: posted scrub script: `scripts/scrub_and_obfuscate.sh` usage: `./scrub_and_obfuscate.sh zephyr-pocs.tar.gz > zephyr-pocs-sanitized.tar.gz`. it strips IPs, replaces hostnames with <REDACTED_HOST>, and deletes tokens.
mika_eng: scrub ran, replaced hostnames, removed token files, converted binaries to pseudo-PoC markdown. uploaded sanitized bundle to s3://redwood-secure/zephyr/2025001111/sanitized/ and updated manifest. audit id: 2025006100.
infra_bot: Audit log: sanitized bundle published by mika_eng at 2025006100. link expiry 30 days. sha256: e3b0c4... zephyr-sanitized-2025001111.sha256
vijay_ciso: Reviewed sanitized artifacts. Approve release under these terms: send sanitized bundle + manifest + CVSS table; if ZEphyr requests raw PoCs require NDA addendum + controlled access; require signed SLA acceptance and designate security liaison (security@redwood.com).
leah_sales: drafting note to ZEphyr sec: attach sanitized bundle, CVSS table, and proposed SLA (crit=3d/high=14d/med=30d). ask if they require raw PoCs under NDA. propose weekly status email on Fridays.
omar_se: opened internal ticket ZP-3344 to track fixes (auth-service and input-sanitizer). ETA critical patch 3 business days. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ZP-3344
mika_eng: also added a temporary mitigation (config flag to rate-limit malformed requests) that can be shipped in 24 hours if prioritized.
leah_sales: ZEphyr sec asked for an exact date. propose: sanitized artifacts shared now, initial mitigation deploy by 2025010000 (~1 business day), full patch rollout by 2025015000 (~5 business days). i'll send that in the email.
vijay_ciso: that's acceptable. note: if customer insists on raw PoCs and refuses NDA, escalate to legal; do not share binaries. also require they sign the risk acceptance template if they won't wait for full patch.
omar_se: attaching one-page Risk Acceptance template into the sanitized bundle. Also added reproduction notes in pseudo-PoC form.
leah_sales: sending email to ZEphyr now; cc vijay_ciso and omar_se. will monitor for NDA requests. :thumbsup:
infra_bot: Notification: sanitized bundle shared with zephyr-security@zephyr-corp.com (pending acceptance).
